feature_name: Vertex AI Search document chunking for RAG
summary: Enable document chunking when creating a Vertex AI Search data store so ingested documents are split into chunks and retrieval for RAG can return chunk-level results.
extended_definition: Enable document chunking when creating a Vertex AI Search data store so ingested documents are split into chunks and retrieval for RAG can return chunk-level results.
